[ff6464]ERROR：イベント状態を取得できませんでした。
Oh, it's the adventurers and...Velly.
So, are you the "people's representatives"? Or\nperhaps "heroes"? The fact that the two pests I\nneed to get rid of are here saves me some trouble.
Shawle...?
It's really you, Shawle...
Lady Velly?
Although you've become bigger now, your eyes and\nyour voice are still the same...\nYou're Shawle. There's no way I'm wrong…
Shawle, what are you doing?! It's a shame to let\nthe anti-Xmas power control you, you know!
Wait, wasn't he originally on the anti-Xmas side?
A shadow that opened the forbidden door and dances\nin the dark night...I'm the Forbidden Shawle.\nI have let go of my past.
You know what? The meaningless festival called\nXmas that you never get tired of celebrating\nevery year...
Now I realize how much it has weakened the world.
In order to save it and set things right, I've\ndecided to get rid of you guys and Navida City.
M-Mr. Shawle!\nWhat do you mean?
What's wrong with Christmas?!
I'm not surprised if you don't understand.\nBecause when your life is stagnant, you're blind\nto impurities. Stagnation equals degeneration.
One can enjoy a comfortable life without anxiety,\nnot simply because they are foolish.
But it's because time has stopped for them.\nThey're dead. What can you expect from those who\nhave even given up on opening their eyes...?
This is bad...Something has completely possessed\nhim. Maybe it's that thing called the Dark Abies~!
To protect your petty pride, you turn your back on\nthings you don't understand. It's so typical of\nyou...
Oh, I forgot. I'm gonna get rid of you anyway, so\nthere's no use lecturing you...Let's just end\nthis.
It seems like you're itching for a fight!\nAlright, I'll beat you to a pulp to make you come\nto your senses!
Wait!
What?
That Shawle seems to be controlled by the Dark\nAbies, but it looks like he still remembers me.
Oh, you're right my lady. He seems to remember you\nand the adventurer.
Yeah, so I wanna remind him of all the good\nmemories we shared to make him want to go back to\nhis old self!
Hm~, will it work though?\nWelp, shall we give it a shot?
I want you to think of some good stories to tell\nhim too!
I'll rack my brain for some good stories too! Mmm!
...You didn't pack your brain in there, did you?
The children were adorable!
The sweet Xmas cake was amazing!
The candles were lovely!
Uh-huh, so you think I should begin with some\ncute and heartwarming stories about the children?
What? Are you ready to fight?
Oh~, what a fun Xmas night!
What did you say?
I'll never forget the joy I had goofing around\nwith the children!
Hm, you're right...They were so energetic and\nhyperactive. Keeping up with them was exhausting.
Yes! I did it! What I said resonated with him!
The cake was delicious!
Hmph, how could you devour such an unhealthy\nthing? I guess Xmas really promotes bad habits.
Hmm~, his reaction wasn’t very positive.
The candlelight made the town look so magical!
W-what are you talking about?!
I was forced to help set up those stupid candles\nand I got burned because of that, you know!\nMy bangs got singed too!
Oh no! Shawle is very angry!
Everyone sang together!
We were looking at the stars!
We were playing hide-and-seek!
Uh-huh, so you think next I should say something\nthat makes Shawle feel good?
Oh~, we should do a Xmas party again~!
What did you say?
Last time, we all had a great time singing\ntogether at the end of the party, right~?!
Hmm, was it because my voice was the clearest?\nBut I still remember you guys made me sing the\nsolo part.
Yes! I did it! He's feeling good and smiling!
We were looking at the stars and we made a wish\ntogether!
Hmph, relying on others to do things for you is\npathetic. The laid-back Xmas vibe must have made\nyou do so.
He doesn't seem to like what he heard. He just\nwent silent with a sullen look on his face.
I'll never forget the fun we had playing\nhide-and-seek!
W-what are you talking about?!
You just quit without telling me and started doing\nsomething else because you couldn't find me! I was\nhiding outside and almost froze to death!
Whoa! Shawle is very angry!
I prepared something to keep you warm!
They always fought over the presents!
Dunder picked the gift carefully!
Uh-huh, so you think lastly I should say something\nthat tugs at Shawle's heartstrings?
Oh~, it's all about presents when it comes to\nXmas~!
What did you say?
I did my best to knit it for you because you\nlooked cold!
It was a scarf, right? I remember. It was\ndefinitely the best present I've ever received\nfrom you, Velly.
Yes! I did it! A warm and gentle smile spreads\nacross his face!
The children loved it too, and they were always\nfighting over the presents!
Hmph, fighting over things is just ugly.\nThe decadent Xmas atmosphere ruins the children\ntoo.
I think I failed. He turned away.
There was a present from Dunder too!\nHe spent ages picking the perfect gift for you!
Oh, now I remember!
It was a very heavy box. When I picked it up, the\nbottom gave out, and a dumbbell fell out and hit\nme! I ended up with a bump on my head!
Oh no! Because of Dunder, he's furious now and\nabout to explode!
I, I'm sorry, Lady Velly...
I admit that I also have feelings about Xmas, but\nthere is a mission I need to complete, so...\nForgive me...
Alright, let's do this!!
I'll put an end to Xmas and destroy Navida! But I\nhave to give you credit for managing to pull it\noff until today!!
I'mma crush y'all!!
After seeing you like this, I'm even more\nconvinced. Xmas really ruins those who celebrate\nand revel in it.
This is the end!
He's about to attack!\nI think you already know, but just in case,\nlemme remind you again. Try not to hurt him!

N-no way...
Huh~? What's that glowing thing~?
Could it be the thing that enables the Dark Abies\nto think?
Sadly, without a body, my journey is over...
I can hear someone talking...
It really seems to be the thing that enables the\nDark Abies to think.
Drowning in comfort, people are losing their will\nto live...To save them. this festival must end...\nFor the sake of the people, for everyone...
Don't underestimate us! I don't know what you've\nseen in the past, but we know how to walk the\nright path!
